text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- For the first time in two years pensions were late and not paid before the holidays because of depleted retirement funds. Pensioners are angry because they were not informed about this delay.
- Long lines of Macedonian cars entered Greece during the Orthodox Easter and May Day holidays, most of them heading for shops in Thessaloniki.

- Leader of opposition IMRO-DPMNY Ljubco Georgievski said Sunday Macedonia was facing economic collapse and it was high time for the party to take responsibility of the country. "We demand early elections in order to see if the citizens really support this kind of state leadership," he said.
- Macedonian students will get 30 percent discount on railway tickets from Monday.

- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov received felicitations for his 80th birthday from throughout the world. Gligorov praised for his wise and peaceful politics. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
